name: pi
notes: Paths verified against pi's own documentation (skills.md, configuration.md, prompt-templates.md) and the pi-mcp-adapter README. Skills deliberately go to ~/.agents/skills/ (the shared Agent Skills location pi documents as natively supported) instead of into pi's agent dir: it keeps ~/.pi clean and lets any other agent that opts into the shared location reuse one copy. The rules document goes to ~/AGENTS.md rather than ~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md because pi loads context files from both the agent directory and the working-directory chain, so writing a second copy under ~/.pi would make the model read the same rules twice.

managed.note: directory-form skills only; flat <name>.md duplicates are reported, never bridged
